shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat stone panel
single principal scene filling the panel
justification: The only correspondence is the most generic one: both are low-relief panels showing profile figures as a single scene, A a quadruped animal (with a smaller creature below) and B two elaborately robed human figures facing each other holding objects. Nothing specific is shared: A has no human figures, no garments, no held attributes and no facing pair, and its animal is rendered in a broad, unarticulated schematic outline, whereas B is densely detailed with fringes, curls, jewellery and modelled musculature.
